caption: The drawing depicts a single glass pitcher with a curved handle, rendered in shades of green and outlined with darker green lines. The pitcher is transparent, and the coloring consists of diagonal green hatching to suggest the texture and reflective quality of the glass. The pitcher has a wide, round body that tapers slightly towards the top, with a spout on one side and an attached handle on the opposite side. There is a small, curled detail of glass at the base of the handle. In the upper right corner of the drawing, there is an inset detail showing a simplified line drawing of the top and neck of the pitcher from a frontal view, highlighting the design of the neck and upper section. The background is an untextured, plain tan or beige color. The artist's signature, "JOHN DANA," appears in the lower right corner.
title: Water Pitcher
